card.name: The 5 in D5W
card.fires_on: The digit 5 inside the abbreviation D5W (5% dextrose in water), in IV diluent and compatibility text. It also fires when the abbreviation is split as D 5 W or D5-W.

modes.label: D5W as diluent
modes.description: The 5 in D5W listed as an IV diluent option next to normal saline.
modes.example: either 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection, USP (normal saline) or 5% Dextrose Injection, USP (D<<5>>W)

card.plain: It marks the 5 in D5W, the dextrose-in-water IV fluid named in dilution instructions.
